name: e-Shram Card
summary: National database registration for unorganised workers, including gig and platform workers. Registered workers get a Universal Account Number (UAN) and become visible to welfare schemes. Registration is free.
eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 16-59 who are not EPFO/ESIC members and not income-tax payers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
summary: Voluntary contributory pension scheme. The worker pays a small monthly amount and the government matches it. Gives an assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60.
eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 18-40 with monthly income up to Rs 15,000, not covered by EPFO/ESIC/NPS.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
summary: Health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospital treatment at empanelled hospitals, cashless.
eligibility: Families identified under SECC data and other notified categories; check eligibility on the official portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
summary: Low-cost yearly accident insurance giving Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or full disability, auto-debited from a bank account.
eligibility: Anyone aged 18-70 with a bank account who opts in.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
summary: Low-cost yearly life insurance of Rs 2 lakh payable to the family on death from any cause.
eligibility: Anyone aged 18-50 with a bank account who opts in.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
summary: Pension scheme giving a guaranteed monthly pension between Rs 1,000 and Rs 5,000 after age 60, depending on contributions.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18-40 with a bank account who are not income-tax payers.

name: PM SVANidhi
summary: Collateral-free working capital loans for street vendors, with higher loan amounts after timely repayment and interest subsidy.
eligibility: Street vendors vending in urban areas with a certificate of vending or recommendation letter.
